description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to the latest .NET framework baseline.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested modernization to the latest framework and Azure modernization readiness.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the current ASP.NET Web Forms application from .NET Framework 4.8 to the latest LTS .NET target and modern project format while preserving functional behavior.

tasks.description: Modernize the application configuration and authentication model for Azure cloud-native services.
tasks.reason: The user requested modernization with cloud-native services as part of Azure adoption.
tasks.requirements: Align application configuration and service connectivity with Azure cloud-native service patterns using managed identity and externally managed runtime configuration where applicable.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security/CVE remediation is required in every modernization plan unless explicitly removed.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If remediation requires a major version update, document impacted dependencies and breaking-change risk, then verify build and tests.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Runtime and build environment established by prior upgrade and transform tasks.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested deploying the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize (if needed by deployment flow), configure runtime settings, and deploy the application to Azure Container Apps using existing Azure resources.
